recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, chest-up portrait of a man with light eyes and short brown hair, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background is a heavily textured, mottled cerulean blue wall. The man wears a dark blazer over a vertically striped shirt. A three-tiered typographic block is justified to the left, occupying the negative space opposite the subject's face.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's eye color matches the dominant background hue
Text block balances the visual weight of the subject's head
Vertical stripes in the shirt echo the verticality of the condensed typeface
Soft lighting on the face contrasts with the rough texture of the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the chest and top of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, particularly the one closest to the center, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves left to the large display text, then down through the subtitle and metadata lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third of the image is dedicated to negative space, providing a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean and slate blue (background and eyes)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and black (blazer and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and light brown hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues, muted tones in the clothing, and naturalistic values in the skin.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues, grays, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the top and bottom lines
Extreme vertical elongation for the middle line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Middle line features ultra-condensed glyphs with high aspect ratios
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a standard geometric sans and an ultra-condensed variant of similar weight.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across three lines of varying widths

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric base for the primary display text.
Provides the extreme verticality required for the secondary text line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution portrait of a man with short brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a dark blazer and a black-and-white vertically striped shirt. Position him on the right side of the frame against a mottled, textured cerulean blue wall. Use soft, directional lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of left-aligned uppercase text in the upper left negative space. Line 1: Large geometric sans-serif in dark gray with wide tracking. Line 2: Ultra-condensed thin sans-serif in white with extreme tracking. Line 3: Small geometric sans-serif in dark gray, matching the width of the lines above.

verificationChecks: Is the text left-aligned and stacked vertically?
Does the background have a visible plaster or paint texture?
Is the subject's eye color harmonious with the background blue?
Is the middle line of text significantly more condensed than the others?

adjustableVariables: Subject's clothing pattern (e.g., different stripe widths)
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure text content is generic or new
postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp focus on the eyes
Ensure the texture of the background does not obscure the text legibility
Verify the three-tier text alignment is perfectly flush left
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject on right + Textured monochromatic background + Left-aligned three-tier sans-serif typography stack.
